otherwise.does: A leaf of the actual observation.

Two observations are compared next; no leaf has been given yet. Whether the command answers (declares an output), and whether the system answered something, are remembered: a command that answers but answered nothing counts as answering null.

The answer is whether the two observations are equal: whether they have the same leaves (in any order of giving; a leaf given twice counts once), where, if the command answers and the system answered nothing, the actual observation also has the leaf `"output"|null|null`. Nothing is forgotten until the next Begin.
A leaf of the expected observation.

descriptions.component: Decides whether the observation of the system after a command equals the one the specification expects.
descriptions.data.actual: The leaves of the actual observation given so far.
descriptions.data.answerAbsent: Whether the command answers (the specification declares an output) but the system answered nothing.
descriptions.data.expected: The leaves of the expected observation given so far.

actualWithLeaf.description: The actual leaves given so far, followed by the leaf just given

answerAbsentNow.description: Whether the command answers (declares an output) and the system answered nothing

expectedWithLeaf.description: The expected leaves given so far, followed by the leaf just given

observationsEqual.description: Whether the set of expected leaves equals the set of actual leaves, the leaf `"output"|null|null` added to the actual ones when the command answers and the system answered nothing (order and repetition do not matter)
